headline: Mooring and Weathered Fronts Sustain Heavy Movement
war_summary: The latest returns show the war’s chief activity still massed in Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, with notable changes at Stlican Shelf. Weathered Expanse remains divided among three Warden, two Colonial, and four neutral bases, but recorded 98 strategic-base events in 24 hours—up from 91 in the previous edition—and ten in the newest two-hour window. Mooring County now lists nine Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral base, a shift from seven, four, and one respectively, while its daily event count eased slightly to 52; four events arrived in the latest two hours. Stlican Shelf has likewise moved to one Warden and eight Colonial bases, compared with two and seven earlier, and posted 18 daily events, including six most recently. Marban Hollow’s one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral position remains unchanged after 13 daily events, with no fresh movement in the latest two hours. Callahan’s Passage retains all ten Warden bases after 11 daily events, also without recent activity. Most other sectors remain quiet, leaving these fronts as the clearest watch points for the next report.
